description: Bilateral Agreement between Ukraine and Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-17
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by 	Hon. Mahindananda Aluthgamage, Minister of Sports,  to sign an Agreement on 	Bilateral Co-operation in the Field of  Sports  between Ukraine and Sri Lanka, was 	approved by the Cabinet.
